control_name: Life & Annuity messages conform to ACORD TXLife
control_objective: Every Life & Annuity message exchanged over the integration platform validates against the ACORD TXLife standard, so that new-business, in-force, and distribution partners exchange structurally conformant Life & Annuity transactions.
risk_addressed: Life & Annuity messages that fail TXLife validation are rejected or mis-parsed by carriers, BGAs, and distribution platforms, stalling new-business submissions and in-force transactions and creating settlement and suitability exposure.

required_data_elements.business_definition: The full TXLife message payload flowing through the integration bus.
The version of the TXLife schema against which the message is validated.

method.summary: Validate a sampled population of Life & Annuity messages against the registered TXLife schema and count any validation failures.
steps: Sample Life & Annuity messages from the integration bus over the assessment period.
Resolve the current TXLife schema version from the schema registry.
Validate each sampled message against TXLife.
Count messages that fail TXLife validation.
method.sampling_rule: Sample all Life & Annuity messages where volume permits; otherwise a representative sample across transaction types.
method.fallback_logic: If the bus or schema registry is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any Life & Annuity message that fails TXLife validation is a conformance exception.

pass_criteria: No sampled Life & Annuity messages fail TXLife validation.
fail_criteria: One or more sampled Life & Annuity messages fail TXLife validation.
exception_handling: Quarantine the offending message flow and re-test before resuming.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each assessment cycle.

actions_on_fail: Notify Integration Architect and Chief Architect
